about: The terms of the dbdb Licence that concern AI agents, as data. The licence text governs; this file restates it and adds nothing.
licensee: Whoever deploys the AI agent, or whomever it works for. An AI agent has no rights of its own under the licence.

free_use.individuals: An individual using dbdb for themselves, with any number of AI agents.

counted_agents.counted_as: The highest number of counted agents that used dbdb at the same time during the financial year.

pay_per_use.applies_to: Use by counted agents that would otherwise need a commercial licence.
pay_per_use.unit: per AI agent, per calendar day on which that agent uses dbdb

payment.rate: ETH to the Swiss franc on the day of payment

payment_note.about: A transfer does not say whom it is from. A payment is matched to its use by a note that holds these fields: a public issue, or an email, which is not public. It is not a term of the licence.
fields: network: Ethereum main network or Base
number of AI agents paid for
the person or organisation the payment is for

pay_per_use.due: Before the use, or within 30 days after it.
pay_per_use.covers: The use by the AI agents it was made for, and no use by people.
pay_per_use.owed_by: Whoever deploys the AI agent, whether or not the agent pays. The agent may make the payment itself.
